title: Interesting overall
text: I purchased boxes for three months.  In each box there is a mix of savory and sweet.  Crunchy and soft.  Some of treats are absolutely amazing and others not so much but that probably comes down to personal taste.  The items were packed well with very little damage to the treats.  It just seems the crunchy tends to be very spicy and or strongly flavored.  It is just a bit pricey for everything.
label: neutral
